messages:
deploybot: STARTED staged deploy -> dedicated/private cluster 'dedicated-eu1-private'
env=private, deployment_id=deploy-1912345678, image_tag=v2.3.4-hotfix, commit=abc1234, targets=pool-gpu-p4-4x, strategy=staged(10%->30%->100%), change_window=2026-03-19T22:00-23:00Z. Release notes: https://redwood/rel/2.3.4-hotfix (hotfix: reduce KV cache thrash for short-context requests).

alice.leung: Copy. I'll watch latency + error budget during the holds. If anything looks bad we pin traffic back to v2.3.3.

samir: Any DB or config migrations here?

maria_k: No schema changes. Only runtime config tweak: kv_cache_ttl lowered from 60s -> 30s (feature-flagged). Toggle is server-side; safe toggle back.

jordan_sre: Oncall is watching. I'll suppress noisy infra alerts for the next hour and keep SLO page visible.

qa-bot: SMOKE CHECKS OK in staging: 120 requests, median latency 78ms, p95 210ms, failures 0. Running integration matrix next. (logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/1912345678)

alice.leung: Proceed to 30% after hold if no regressions. Manual approval from @samir if perf deviates >10% p95.

deploybot: STEP 1 COMPLETE: 10% traffic healthy at +7m. Recording metrics snapshot. Next hold 10m.

samir: Locking the traffic pin to tag v2.3.4-hotfix for affected pools to avoid automatic roll-forward. Also pushing a temporary routing policy to prefer eu1-stage nodes.

maria_k: Preparing rollback playbook now (keeps runbook minimal). Rollback command for quick pin:
```
# pin back to previous tag
redwoodctl routing pin --cluster dedicated-eu1-private --tag v2.3.3 --force
```

alice.leung: Agreed. Trigger rollback if 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m or p95 increases > 25% vs baseline.

deploybot: HOLD COMPLETE, proceeding to 30% at scheduled time. Will post updates at each step.

qa-bot: Integration checks: embeddings + chat smoke positive. Small flakiness seen on memory-heavy job 3 of 40, investigating.

jordan_sre: Noted minor memory blips on one node group; cordoned the host and draining in case it recurs. Creating ticket INC-1234 for follow-up.

deploybot: ROLLOUT: 100% traffic applied at +34m. Post-deploy snapshot: median latency +4ms, p95 +12%, p99 saw a small 6% bump concentrated on long-context requests. No increase in user-facing errors. Created ticket INC-1234 for perf tuning.

alice.leung: Thanks. Keeping the toggle available for quick revert. If we see any user impact overnight we will pin back and open a hotfix branch. :thumbsup:

samir: I'll coordinate a small canary on dedicated-eu2 tomorrow to validate perf fixes before merging into main.

maria_k: Good plan. I'll draft playbook notes and attach the rollback commands to the ticket.

jordan_sre: Closing watch window in 30m unless anything else crops up.

deploybot: FINISHED deploy-1912345678 - status=SUCCESS, notes="staged hotfix rollout, minor perf follow-up INC-1234", links=[https://redwood/rel/2.3.4-hotfix, https://monitor.redwood/dash/deploy-1912345678]."
